disruptions.summary: Amended Transport for Wales service between Birmingham International and Llandudno Junction today
disruptions.description:
As a result of more trains than usual requiring repair at the same time, fewer Transport for Wales services are able to operate between Birmingham International and Llandudno Junction today.

Trains that would ordinarily run directly between Birmingham International and Llandudno Junction will be revised to run between Birmingham International and Chester only. These services will not serve Flint, Prestatyn, Rhyl, Colwyn Bay or Llandudno Junction.

This is expected until the end of the day today.

Customer advice:

You are advised to please travel on the next service, where available.

Pay as you go customers:

Pay as you go is only valid on Transport for Wales and CrossCountry services. If you travel with another operator or on a local bus service, you will need to buy an alternative ticket before boarding.

If all or part of your journey requires a rail replacement bus, please tap in at your origin station and tap out at your destination. Station colleagues can assist if you need to tap out at a gateline after travelling on a rail replacement bus. You can also add any missing taps using the Transport for Wales app or website.

If you wish to abandon your journey, please tap out at the same station within one hour of tapping in.

You can check services running in the area using the Transport for Wales live map.

Check before you travel:

You can check your journey using the National Rail real-time Journey Planner.

Compensation:

You may be entitled to compensation if you experience a delay in completing your journey today. Please keep your train ticket and make a note of your journey, as both will be required to support any claim.
